mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600.0 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for dwellings, which correlates with higher household spending and construction activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 600.0 thousand units in the prior month but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.2% for two consecutive months, it indicates aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for two months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) in the prior month signals a strengthening labor market that drives consumer spending growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in the prior month but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it indicates supply contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 90.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 221.0 indicates inflationary pressure that triggers interest rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 221.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for two months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 600.0 thousand units signals strong housing demand, which drives consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both exceed 600.0 thousand units but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 8.5%, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 8.5% but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.
